leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript generics to create a reusable polling hook with typed parameters and return values.
Implement the useState hook to manage polling state variables like data, error, and loading status.
Utilize the useEffect hook to control the lifecycle of polling intervals and cleanup.
Execute conditional logic to handle different polling states (loading, success, error) and control UI rendering.
Construct interval-based polling logic using setInterval to fetch data at regular intervals.
Define cleanup functions within useEffect to clear intervals and prevent memory leaks when components unmount.
Invoke fetch API calls within the polling interval to retrieve updated data from an endpoint.
Handle asynchronous operations with async/await syntax to manage data fetching within the polling hook.
Return structured hook output including data, error states, and loading indicators for consumption by components.
Modify polling behavior by adjusting interval duration and conditional execution based on component needs.
Apply error handling mechanisms to catch and store fetch errors during polling operations.
Control polling activation using boolean flags or dependencies to start/stop polling dynamically.
